liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Picasso Moon** (2 reviews): The end of Picasso Moon is singled out as intensely hot; Reviewer likes Picasso Moon as an opener and praises the Let It Grow [14][25]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Jerry plays slide on his final solo, with solo spots for Welnick and Hornsby [15]
- **Walkin' Blues** (1 review): Jerry unexpectedly joins in singing the 'Don't Mind Dyin'' line [15]
- **Candyman** (1 review): Jerry varies the Shotgun line, adding doubt by singing he would 'probably' send the target straight to hell [15]
- **High Time** (1 review): Reviewer calls High Time the standout of an otherwise unremarkable setlist [14]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Reviewer met their future partner during Eyes of the World at this show [19]
- **All Along The Watchtower** (1 review): Jerry's playing coming out of space into Watchtower is called the best Watchtower ever [16]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Let It Grow is called good [25]

## Setlist highlights

- **Sunshine Daydream, Encore Break**: rare: 13 archived performances [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-08-13.119112.akg451.darby.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 17 songs; 159 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1991-08-13.sbd.miller.109241.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 165 min; rated 3.56/5 by 9 [3]. Said about its sound: Bobby's vocals sound a little gravelly, but the band is tight [24]
- **gd1991-08-13.150331.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 165 min [4]
- **gd1991-08-13.wklitz.me80.91678.flac**: source not stated; 16 songs; 167 min; rated 3.6/5 by 5 [7]. Said about its sound: Audience recording described as very nice sounding [22]
- **gd1991-08-13.148403.fob.BK4011.ebel.flac16**: source not stated; 16 songs; 164 min [8]
- **gd1991-08-13.143088.FOB.Schoeps.unknown.Dalton.Miller.Noel.t-flac1644**: source not stated; 16 songs; 165 min [9]. Said about its sound: The digital recording had many dropouts and digital noise, and lost several songs including Sugaree and Walkin' Blues [9]
- **gd91-08-13.sbd.oconnor.10927.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 157 min; rated 3.33/5 by 6 [10]. Said about its sound: Sound is great, but the recording skips during one of Jerry's best moments; Hornsby is mixed far too high, as if a monitor mix; Picasso Moon worst, improves later, with glitches [16][17]

## Around the show

- Reviewer stood ten feet from Jerry and Bruce; Jerry seemed loose and was having fun with Bruce [16]
- Cal Expo is an outdoor venue with room to roam, dance, or sit in the grandstand; reviewer guesses about 20,000 capacity [22]
- Reviewer thinks Cal Expo held only 8,000-10,000, the smallest place they saw the Dead [23]
- The soundboard feed to all recorders cut out twice during set 2 [4]
- Reviewer finds night 3 had the stronger setlist, but personally preferred this show [14]
- Reviewer rates this and the other 1991 Cal Expo shows from Charlie Miller as superb [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-08-13.119112.akg451.darby.flac16**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; AKGC451EB/CK1's (DIN/DFC/Middle Of OTS/6 Feet High)> Whirlwind Phantoms>Sony TC-D5M,Tapes TDK MA-X Set 1,Sony Metal E-S… [1]
- **gd1991-08-13.sbd.miller.109241.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat (44.1k) [3]
- **gd1991-08-13.150331.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  June 28, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [4]. Also: Soundboard recording by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; Schoeps master DAT supplies patches for Drums and Watchtower [4]
- **gd1991-08-13.wklitz.me80.91678.flac**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Sennheiser ME-80's>Technics SV-MD1 [7]
- **gd1991-08-13.148403.fob.BK4011.ebel.flac16**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: FOB B&K 4011-> DAT [8]. Also: B&K 4011 front-of-board source; Schoeps CMC 32 filler covers a Let It Grow bust and set 2 tuning [8]
- **gd1991-08-13.143088.FOB.Schoeps.unknown.Dalton.Miller.Noel.t-flac1644**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: unknown taper: Schoeps Omni MK2 (spaced 12') > Oade Custom Pre Amp > Panasonic SV-255 > Master DAT > PCM; Charlie Miller [9]. Also: Schoeps PCM recording shared by Tim Dalton, transferred by Charlie, with patches from ME-80 and other sources [9]
- **gd91-08-13.sbd.oconnor.10927.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>CM>DAT>CDR [10]

## Art and photos
